title: The retarded-scarcity wake: moving gravity through a substrate
headline: Delayed-center shortcut fails as a Poisson-vacuum field; the explicit boost-violating equation (Branch C) was written and closed — its dissipative parameter drags the Sun at a rate the ephemeris floor excludes. No observable galactic wake survives in the minimal local class.

claims.claim: A localized scarcity source has a potential-like scalar that increases numerically from the deep center toward the edge, while its gradient attracts matter inward
claims.evidence: By construction in [scarcity-grid-weight-black-hole](../../../orrery/lab/sims/scarcity-grid-weight-black-hole/) and [scarcity-capped-cumulative-field](../../../orrery/lab/sims/scarcity-capped-cumulative-field/); inherited only as mechanics from [gravity-as-scarcity](../gravity-as-scarcity/), not as evidence that nature uses scarcity

claims.claim: There exists a physical gravitational substrate with a locally meaningful velocity field **U**, distinct in principle from the CMB frame
claims.evidence: Moot: Branch C closed (ORB-11175). No source law or direct evidence; an O(1) substance coupling to a preferred frame is already bounded by [lorentz-violation-bounds](../../studies/lorentz-violation-bounds.md); an excitation-medium reading can hide uniform motion at leading order ([river-model-and-analog-gravity](../../studies/river-model-and-analog-gravity.md)). The minimal gravitational-sector coupling to such a U — an aether-frame dissipation — is now bounded to \(\ell_\Gamma>10\)–\(100\) kpc by the solar-system drag it implies ([Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md)); whether U exists with no gravitational coupling at all is a question this family no longer asks
claims.comparator: Lorentz-violation bounds and analog-gravity hiding of uniform motion, not an O(1) aether wind.

claims.claim: Under the delayed-center postulate, uniform translation produces a first-order potential dipole proportional to \(v/c_g\), with higher conventional potential on the leading edge and stronger attraction on the trailing edge
claims.evidence: The algebra is internally consistent, but \(\Phi_{\rm lag}\) is not the compact-source exterior solution of the standard Poisson equation: it has \(\nabla^2\Phi\neq0\) outside the galaxy and a linearly divergent Poisson-equivalent dipole moment. The analytic check awaits a cataloged negative-control fixture — [moving-source-field-consistency](../moving-source-field-consistency/)
claims.kill: Cataloged negative-control fixture confirms Laplace-forbidden n≥1 terms and the linearly divergent dipole.

claims.claim: The first-order acceleration contrast is \((g_{\rm trail}-g_{\rm lead})/g_0\simeq4\beta_g\)
claims.evidence: Analytically corrected to \(2\beta_g\) in § Leading/trailing sign. \(4\beta_g\) follows from a *different*, non-potential force rule than the declared \(\mathbf{a}=-\nabla\Phi\); the fixture remains to be cataloged — [moving-source-field-consistency](../moving-source-field-consistency/)
claims.kill: Cataloged fixture: declared a=−∇Φ gives 2β_g, not 4β_g.

claims.claim: The alternative "force points toward the retarded position" rule is a legitimate conservative mechanic
claims.evidence: Analytically it has nonzero curl and admits loop-dependent work \(\sim\beta_g GM/R\); constant-\(R\) circles return zero, so the fixture must vary eccentricity and apsidal orientation — [moving-source-field-consistency](../moving-source-field-consistency/)
claims.kill: Cataloged fixture: nonzero curl and loop-dependent work.

claims.claim: A centrally concentrated galaxy preserves a larger coherent wake than a diffuse distribution with the same total mass
claims.evidence: Moot for the rejected delayed-center shortcut, and false for the explicit Branch C equation: at first order the exterior dipole of the dissipative term is set by the far field of the Newtonian potential, i.e. by total mass alone, so \(A_1(r)\to\beta_g r/2\ell_\Gamma\) independent of central concentration up to \(O(a/r)\); the source-delay term is a rigid shift of the whole potential, likewise concentration-blind — [Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md) § The first-order moving-source solution (ORB-11175)
claims.kill: Fired: the minimal Branch C amplitude is concentration-independent.

claims.claim: The wake displaces the dynamical center behind the baryonic center and produces an \(m=1\) leading/trailing rotation asymmetry rather than an axisymmetric flat-curve boost
claims.evidence: Refuted on both counts by the explicit equation (ORB-11175, [Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md)): the dissipative solution's first-order leading/trailing *radial* contrast vanishes (the first-order force is tangential, \(g_0A_1\sin\theta\), zero on the leading/trailing axis), and the amplitude itself is capped by the solar-system self-acceleration wall at \(A_1(10\,{\rm kpc})\lesssim10^{-3}\)–\(3\times10^{-5}\), two to three orders below observed lopsidedness ([solar-system-ephemeris-precision-floor](../../studies/solar-system-ephemeris-precision-floor.md)). The source-delay term displaces the centre, but by a fixed \(\lvert\tau_s\rvert w<R_\odot\), unobservable at galactic radii
claims.kill: Fired: no first-order radial contrast in the minimal class, and the amplitude is bounded below observability.

claims.claim: A correlation between observed asymmetry axes and a common inferred substrate velocity would be evidence for the wake (§ Observable signatures, last bullet; rejection gate 6)
claims.evidence: Moot: Branch C closed (ORB-11175). The conditional stands as logic, but no surviving model predicts an amplitude above \(10^{-3}\), and the cosmological baseline it would have needed — the leading tidal tensor is quadrupolar and does not by itself establish an \(m=1\) phase correlation ([moving-source-field-consistency](../moving-source-field-consistency/) § A degeneracy to measure, not assume) — is no longer owed by this family
claims.kill: Moot: Branch C closed. Reopening needs daniel_reopen and an amplitude above the ephemeris ceiling.

claims.claim: A boost-violating model may produce a lopsidedness-versus-vertical-distortion split set partly by the angle between \(\mathbf{w}\) and the disk normal
claims.evidence: Moot: Branch C closed (ORB-11175). In the minimal equation the split exists in form — in-plane \(\mathbf{w}\) gives the tangential \(m=1\) force, perpendicular \(\mathbf{w}\) a \(1/R\) midplane vertical acceleration (bowl-like, not an integral-sign warp) — at amplitudes the ephemeris floor caps below \(10^{-3}\) ([Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md))
claims.kill: Moot: Branch C closed. Reopening needs daniel_reopen and an amplitude above the ephemeris ceiling.

claims.claim: A specified boost-invariant causal field can cancel the delayed-center model's first-order dipole while retaining finite propagation speed
claims.evidence: Previously conjecture pending the local study note; supported 2026-08-28 by [moving-source-gravity-bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md) § aberration cancellation (Heaviside/Liénard–Wiechert exact for uniform motion; Carlip 2000 through \(O((v/c)^5)\) radiation-reaction order in general relativity), and reproduced inside the Branch C equation with its time-odd sector off — the Heaviside form, even in \(\xi_\parallel\) at every order in \(\beta_g\) for every \(c_g\) ([Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md) § The control). A calibration result for specified equations, not a verdict on every preferred-medium equation — which is why Branch C had to be written

Previously conjecture while an extra substrate mode's coupling was unspecified; refuted for this wake's field once the sourced wall and Branch C fixed that scope. GW170817 pins the observed tensor speed near \(c\) ([scalar-gravity-ppn-constraints](../../studies/scalar-gravity-ppn-constraints.md)) and Moore & Nelson give Cherenkov bounds of \(c-c_g<2\times10^{-15}c\) (Galactic) and ~\(2\times10^{-19}c\) (extragalactic) for any conventionally coupled mode ([moving-source-gravity-bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md) § gravitational Cherenkov). The escape through an extra, differently coupled substrate mode closed with Branch C: its potential is the conventionally coupled one ([Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md) § Walls). Galaxies at \(10^{-3}c\) never outrun the field

claims.claim: The new velocity-dependent branch rescues the parent scarcity theory's fixed-β galactic law, photon sector, or source-law debt
claims.evidence: It does not address those failures. The parent ledger remains controlling: [gravity-as-scarcity](../gravity-as-scarcity/)
